entities.title: Two notes in the folder no longer match the code
entities.summary: wrangler.jsonc calls the game open to everyone, and the README names the wrong build folder.
entities.expected: The notes say what the code does: the game's page needs a sign-in, and npm run build writes the site to dist/games/retro/hivestorm/.
entities.observed: wrangler.jsonc's opening comment says the Worker serves "the static game, open to everyone", but gamePage() and the assets' run_worker_first make the page need a sign-in (as the same file's assets comment says). The README's Code section says npm run build makes "static site in dist/retro/hivestorm/", but build.mjs's BASE_PATH puts it in dist/games/retro/hivestorm/.
acceptanceCriteria: wrangler.jsonc's opening comment says the page needs a sign-in and the table is public.

origin.description: Found while documenting Hivestorm's folders, reading the comments against worker/index.ts and build.mjs.
